text_block_list.text: We attend a meet and greet for fans and their families.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! It's time for lunch, everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: C-Curren! Um… This is my omelet…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! It looks delicious! It's so fluffy and shiny!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! My mom's omelets are the best! You can try some too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you! Okay, Mom, I'll have just one bite!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: So cute! B-by all means, have as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Boy
text_block_list.text: C-Curren! You can have some of my lunch too!

text_block_list.name: Precocious Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey, no fair! I wanna give Curren my whole lunch! My dad's rice balls are top-class!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! Everything?! You're all so sweet. I dunno if I can eat all this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But hey, umm… aren't these your favorite foods? I'd feel bad if I ate them all myself…

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: IT'S FINE!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …W-wow! Really? Maybe we should ask your parents first…

text_block_list.name: Parents
text_block_list.text: WE'D BE HONORED!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… Are you suuuure?

text_block_list.name: Parents
text_block_list.text: Oh. My. GOSH! Curren Chan, you're so cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone uploads their pictures to social media after that, and before long, #CurrenChanMeetandGreet is trending at number one!
